pace.text: Final pages. One hand, one ink throughout. No erasures. No corrections.
In his murder my crimes are consummated; the miserable series of my being is wound to its close!

dismissed.expected: a repast was prepared for me in the desert that restored and inspirited me the fare was indeed coarse such as the peasants of the country ate but i will not doubt that it was set there by the spirits that i had invoked to aid me
